title: Decide exact finite signability with an exponential-time polynomial-space search
statement: For each signing form integer M_s=4(d-1)I-A_s^2. Exact PSD equivalence checks sharpness. One option computes h(z)=det(zI+M_s): symmetry gives real eigenvalues, hence PSD iff all coefficients are nonnegative; a negative eigenvalue would give a forbidden positive root. Fix a spanning tree and switch its signs to+1 by diagonal unitary vertex switching, preserving norm and squared characteristic polynomial. Enumerate the remaining m-n+1 signs. This yields an exact uniform2^(m-n+1)*poly(B)-time, polynomial-space finite decision/search for connected inputs. It does not provide the required polynomial deterministic/expected constructor or an actual promised-base counterexample. PSD/switching primitives were already available and count once.
